name: Render
description: Executes the DaVinci Resolve orchestrator to render the final video.

inputs.name: timeline_notes
inputs.description: The captain's own notes typed onto the built timeline in DaVinci Resolve, routed to this step because this step owns the decision each note is about. Injected by the runner from <project>/marker_feedback/ and absent when there are none. See library/tools/marker_routing.py.

outputs.name: render_output
outputs.description: State output: render_output, including a per-item transition_items report with each requested and compiled type, exact anchor frame when stated, requested duration in its stated unit, compiled duration_frames, and any downgrade reason. A transition that cannot sit on a real cut must remain visible as downgraded in this report.

outputs.name: render_watch_frames
outputs.description: A map of the frame strips drawn off the EXPORTED FILE, with the directory holding them, the sampling resolution, the questions a still can answer and the boundary of what it cannot. Prompt-only: it is what makes this step's review see the rendered picture. See library/tools/render_watch.build_watch_block. Drawn only when PIPELINE_PERCEPTUAL_QA is set - the flag stays off by default - and absent otherwise, when the handoff says the picture was not seen rather than claiming it was. The same shape step_6_02_validate_output carries, so it is withheld from a harness that cannot be shown a picture (window_frames.FRAME_INPUTS) with no runner change.

outputs.name: visual_qa
outputs.description: Frame-grab and segment-check verdicts the build produced behind PIPELINE_PERCEPTUAL_QA, emitted only when non-empty and absent on a default run. Read by this step's own LLM review through the VISUAL_QA_INSTRUCTIONS addition, which records the absence when there is no table. See library/tools/visual_qa_router.py.

outputs.name: render_review
outputs.description: The narrative half of this step: what the review SAW in the export it just built - the strips when they were drawn, the manifest and the measurements otherwise. Shape: {"overall": "clean"|"concerns"|"not_watched", "notes": ["one line per span or concern"]}. Written by the model, read by the run summary (library/tools/render_review.py). Advisory only: 6.02's validation is the gate with teeth.

llm_outputs.name: render_review
llm_outputs.description: The narrative verdict on the export this step just built, in the shape the render_review output declares. The ONLY key the model is asked for: render_output, render_watch_frames and visual_qa are all measured by the deterministic build, and asking the model to echo them back was the defect (finding 11, execution-frontier report 2026-09-24).
